sloka: एकेन खलु बाणेन मर्मणि अभिहते मयि ।द्वाव् अन्धौ निहतौ वृद्धौ माता जनयिता च मे ॥२-६३-४२॥
transliteration: ekena khalu bāṇena marmaṇi abhihate mayi ।dvāv andhau nihatau vṛddhau mātā janayitā ca me ॥2-63-42॥

translations.english: 'By striking at the vital part of my body with one arrow, you have killed both my aged and blind mother and father too.
